description: One year time series of relative electric photovoltaic power dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors K T Malkow (European Commission, Joint Research Centre). The datasets (in dat file format) contain ordered time series (in unit of hours with 15 minutes time resolution) of relative electric photovoltaic (PV) power (expressed in percentage) of one randomly selected year (05 August 2022 to 04 August 2023) and four of its constituting weeks (01 to 07 SEP 2022, 02 to 08 JAN ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
